readout_other: hind limb EMG (gastrocnemius); H&E, VAF-toluidine blue, GFAP and caspase-3 histology; post-sonication behavioural monitoring
direction_notes: 0.5 and 1 ms pulse durations increased EMG amplitude in the hind limb contralateral to sonication compared with no-FUS; 2 ms did not; response rates did not differ across pulse durations.
safety_notes: No abnormal behaviour during survival; H&E, VAF-toluidine blue, GFAP and caspase-3 histology at 24 h and 1 month showed no tissue damage.

timing.protocol_description: 200 ms stimuli at 70% duty cycle with pulse durations 0.5, 1 and 2 ms (PRF 1,400, 700, 350 Hz respectively), randomised with no-FUS trials at 4.8 s intervals; 50 trials per parameter per session, 5 sessions per animal.
